title: SHEIN on Trustpilot: score, complaints and what the numbers show
seoTitle: SHEIN on Trustpilot: score and complaints
description: SHEIN scores 3.8 out of 5 on Trustpilot, with reservations. See what over 350,000 reviews show, the complaints about packages and refunds, and why the score is global.
metaDescription: SHEIN on Trustpilot on October 28, 2026: TrustScore 3.8 from 353,435 reviews, 59% five stars and 18% one star, complaints about delivery and refunds. See what the score does not show.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: SHEIN scores 3.8 out of 5 on Trustpilot, with reservations. That score came from 353,435 reviews by customers in many countries, and the themes in the negative reviews we read are packages that never arrived and refunds that were late or denied. The profile is global and does not separate countries.

contentSections.heading: What the score measures
paragraphs: The TrustScore is the profile's rating on Trustpilot. It adds up the whole purchase, not only the quality of the items. On October 28, 2026, SHEIN had 3.8, with the label "Great", from 353,435 reviews; 22,625 of them were posted in the last 12 months. The profile is claimed by the company and has a paid Trustpilot subscription, as the page itself states.
The breakdown by star, in the same reading: 59% five stars, 12% four, 6% three, 5% two and 18% one. Five and four stars make up most of the reviews.

image.alt: Bars from five stars to one with the breakdown of SHEIN's Trustpilot reviews: 59%, 12%, 6%, 5% and 18%
image.caption: Breakdown of SHEIN's Trustpilot reviews by star. Our chart.

contentSections.heading: Three readings that change the picture
paragraphs: First, the one-star share. 18% of the reviews give one star, more than the 11% of two and three stars combined, and that is where the complaints appear.

Second, replying is not resolving. SHEIN replied to 98% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and the page notes that the company may use AI in its replies. The text of the replies was not read, so the numbers do not say whether they solved the problem of the person who complained.

Third, the score is global. The profile does not split reviews by country, and shoppers with different shipping, delivery times and customs rules sit in one rating. How delivery to your country will go is not in this number.

contentSections.heading: What the complaints say
paragraphs: The negative reviews visible on the profile on October 28, 2026 were read for their themes, without counting or ranking them. They revolve around the package and the money:
bullets: A package that was lost, stolen or never delivered, sometimes with a delivery photo the customer disputes.
A refund that took a long time or was denied, including returns the store said it never received.
Customer service that was slow or answered with templated replies.
Product problems: size, quality, the wrong item or a missing item.

image.alt: Illustration of a tracking screen with the delivery stalled and the house still waiting, next to a receipt with a barcode and a coin with a return arrow, the refund
image.caption: Our illustration of the parcel that does not arrive and of the refund, the complaint themes. Keep the receipt and the tracking number.

postParagraphs: These are the themes in the reviews we read, not a measure of how often an order goes wrong. They say where to look: the tracking after dispatch, the proof of delivery, the return receipt and the refund request.

contentSections.heading: What the praise says
paragraphs: The positive reviews visible in the same reading were few, so this is a small sample. Their themes are different:
bullets: Delivery that went through without problems.
postParagraphs: Praise and complaint describe different moments of the purchase: the praise speaks of the catalog, the price and the parcel that arrived; the complaint, of the parcel that did not arrive and the refund that did not come. The score adds both together.

contentSections.heading: Trustpilot: who writes the reviews, and from where
paragraphs: The profile read, the one for www.shein.com, is global: it does not split reviews by country, and the page does not say how many came from your country or any other. The score mixes shoppers from different countries, with different shipping, delivery times and customs rules.

Trustpilot has regional sites, and the one for the United Kingdom showed the same profile, with the same numbers. The other regional sites were not opened, so the text does not say whether any of them shows anything different.
So the score speaks for the store's customers worldwide, not for how an order to your address will go.

contentSections.heading: Our check
paragraphs: The numbers come from a public reading, made without logging in, of SHEIN's Trustpilot profile:
bullets: The score, the number of reviews, the breakdown by star, the reply rate and the visible reviews, which is where the themes came from.
The scope of the profile, which is global, and the United Kingdom regional site, which showed the same one.
postParagraphs: What was not read: the text of the store's replies, reviews by country, and Trustpilot's regional sites other than the United Kingdom one. That is why the text does not say whether the replies resolve anything.
The numbers change every month. Check the profile on the day you buy.

contentSections.heading: Can you trust SHEIN based on Trustpilot?
paragraphs: Going by Trustpilot, the numbers are these: a TrustScore of 3.8, "Great", from 353,435 reviews, 59% of them five stars and 18% one star, with 98% of negative reviews answered, usually within 24 hours.

The caveats are about scope and theme. The profile is global and does not separate countries, so it says how the store behaves overall, not how an order to your address will go. And the negative reviews we read are about packages that never arrived and about refunds that were late or denied: the score alone does not tell you how often that happens.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: The complaints point to what to protect. Buy through SHEIN's official site or app for your country and keep the payment receipt and the tracking number: they show what was paid and where the parcel stopped.
If the parcel does not arrive or the item is wrong, request the refund through the store's own channel, on the site or in the app, and keep the return receipt if you send something back.
Before buying, open a few one-star reviews on the profile and read the store's reply under each one, especially the ones about packages that did not arrive and about refunds.
To see who runs SHEIN in your country and where the company is from, read [Is SHEIN legit and safe?](/en/reviews/is-shein-legit-and-safe).
If you have decided to buy, the [SHEIN page](/en/coupons/shein) leads to the official site.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does SHEIN have a good score on Trustpilot? The TrustScore was 3.8, with the label "Great", from 353,435 reviews; 59% gave five stars and 18% gave one.

What are the most common complaints about SHEIN? In the negative reviews read, the themes were packages that were lost, stolen or never arrived, sometimes with a disputed delivery photo; refunds that were late or denied, including returns the store said it never received; slow or templated customer service; and product problems such as size, quality, the wrong item or a missing item. The themes were noted, not counted.

Does SHEIN reply to negative reviews? According to the Trustpilot profile, the store replied to 98% of negative reviews, usually within 24 hours, and the reply may use AI. The text of the replies was not read.

Does the Trustpilot score apply to my country? Not on its own. The profile is global and does not split reviews by country, and the United Kingdom regional site showed the same profile. The score describes the store overall; delivery times and return rules for your country are on SHEIN's official site or app.
